requirement_text.REQ-419: Build-order M1 (docs/mobile/build-order.md): MOB-1 in docs/mobile/requirements.md, placement and stack per docs/mobile/architecture.md §2, stack settled by docs/migration/decisions/0012-mobile-tier-stack.md (not re-decided here). This requirement creates apps/mobile/; nothing in it authenticates or fetches (that is REQ-421). BUILDS a Flutter scaffold with three static guards under apps/mobile/test/guards/ (module boundary, forbidden dependencies, no compiled-in tenant identifier), each with a self-test proving it fires on a violating fixture, and a renderer registry with an explicit unsupported-definition-type fallback widget verified by a widget test.

task.description: Per WF-02 Step 3's own note: 'Dart tests under apps/mobile/test/ are written by MOBILE-DEV in the mobile step (2b-mobile) ... and TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR still reviews them against the acceptance criteria.' MOBILE-DEV has already written all the Dart test code for REQ-419 in Step 2b-mobile (three guard tests + their self-tests under apps/mobile/test/guards/, and a widget test under apps/mobile/test/widgets/) -- read them directly on branch feature/WF02-REQ419-20260927. Your job here is NOT to write new Dart test code (that would duplicate MOBILE-DEV's already-written, already-passing tests) -- it is to write test/specs/REQ-419.md documenting: the requirement text, each existing test case (file + test name), and why each exists (which acceptance criterion it covers). Verify every one of REQ-419's 8 acceptance criteria maps to at least one existing test case in apps/mobile/test/ (or, for the criteria that are command-output demonstrations rather than unit tests -- e.g. flutter build apk --debug succeeding, the Podfile grep, the git ls-files directory check -- name that they are verified by direct command execution/inspection rather than a test file, per this run's Step 2b-mobile result already quoting that real output). If you find a genuine coverage gap (an acceptance criterion with no corresponding test AND no command-output demonstration), report it as an issue rather than silently passing it through.
acceptance_criteria: test/specs/REQ-419.md written, mapping every one of REQ-419's 8 acceptance criteria to either an existing test file+case or a command-output demonstration
No new .dart test files written (MOBILE-DEV already wrote them in Step 2b-mobile)
Any genuine coverage gap found is reported as an issue, not silently passed
